mis_merges.label: credit quality stress
subjects: AI-related corporate debt/CDS stress (Oracle, Broadcom, CCC spreads, IG yield)
Private-credit default-rate methodology debate (BDC/PIK loans, Cliffwater vs. reported rates)
mis_merges.why: The private-credit BDC/PIK debate (5 of 12 cards, all J.P. Morgan) is a distinct, data-rich, pulse-worthy story about actual vs. reported default rates with no AI-debt content at all; filed under a label framed by Oracle/Broadcom CDS prints, an editor scanning labels would plausibly never surface it as its own theme.

mis_merges.label: ai chip capacity buildout
subjects: AI chip/foundry capacity buildout (TSMC, ASML, AMD, Terafab, Intel)
AI debt financing for chip purchases (Broadcom/Oracle/SpaceX)
mis_merges.why: The debt-financing content is a minority tail (3 of 9 cards) that only restates facts already fully present in the dedicated 'credit quality stress' and 'sovereign capital crowding out' labels, so its presence here is unlikely to flip which theme an editor leads with.

notes: misc is the declared overflow (12/1619 cards, ~0.7%) and is excluded from fragmentation per the frozen rule. Two of the eight fragmentation sets (equity supply/demand framework; Iran market-reaction vs. diplomatic-standoff) are closer judgment calls than the other six, but the mis-merge finding on 'credit quality stress' fails the gate on its own regardless of how those two sets are scored.
